## Install

Download the archive for your system, unpack it and plug in the USB stick. Then run one of these in the unpacked folder.

Make a new stick (this erases it):

```
sudo ./stela setup
```

Update an existing Stela stick to v@VERSION@:

```
sudo ./stela setup update stela
```

On Windows, open Terminal with Run as administrator and write `.\stela.exe` in place of `sudo ./stela`.

Then boot the PC from the stick.

## Changes

## Boot log

If Stela does not work, include the boot log in your report:

```
sudo ./stela setup boot-log
```
